purpose: Grey panel card: icon glyph, h5 title and (usually) a short body paragraph. Used by benefits-stack (homepage and 14 inner-page instances) in 3-col or 2-col grids.

body.note: BODY COPY, budget from level-c slot lengths: measured 7-25 words. Absent on the title-only variant (first benefits-stack on the six industry pages).

variants.with-body: icon + title + paragraph (all pages except industry first stack)
variants.title-only: icon + title (industry pages first stack, 3 cards)

motion.delayRule: card i (1-based) has inline transitionDelay (i)*50ms, measured 50ms..300ms on cards
motion.reducedMotionFallback: Design rule (site has no prefers-reduced-motion handling): show cards at final opacity/position with no stagger delay.

responsive.grid: grid-cols-1 below 800px; from 800px md:grid-cols-3 (or md:grid-cols-2 when the stack has 2 or 4 cards)

evidence.structure: structure measured against live coda.co (~1px, CLONE_SPEC.md); no copy in this contract
evidence.copy: a-exact on /, b on 4 pages, c on 9 pages; budgets from measured lengths

measuredFrom.quote: benefits-stack-inner-card w-full text-wrap rounded-md bg-grey-0 p-5 h-full
